question: Which of the following hills is NOT located in Meghalaya?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Javadi.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The hill station 'Javadi' is located in Tamil Nadu.**
 
• Javadi hills are spread across parts of the Vellore and Tiruvannamalai districts in the northern part of the state of Tamil Nadu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Northeastern Plateau - **Meghalaya plateau is an extension of the peninsular plateau but is separated from the Rajmahal hills by the Malda fault**. Further Meghalaya plateau is subdivided into three-

 
 
• **Garo hills.**
 
• **Khasi hills.**
 
• **Jaintia hills**
